en:
Shuichi...
I think you are misunderstanding something...
Misunderstanding...?
Do you think I am the perfect maid?

From what you've told me,
you're absolutely flawless...

And with your support, anyone can
be incredibly successful.
*sigh* While I do appreciate that...

I do not prefer being called a
"perfect maid machine."
<CLT=cltMIND>I don't think I ever said that...

Besides, it is close to impossible to help
those without potential to succeed.
Well, that may be, but...

But there have been times when I was unable
to support even those with potential...
Huh?

There was such a time when I had just
started my career as a maid.

A businessman hired me. And he was
brimming with ambition and talent.

I knew he would become famous,
so I did everything I could.

I took care of his daily needs and gave him
advice. I even worked as his secretary at times.

When my master was busy, I would take
his place giving orders to his employees.

That is how the company steadily grew.
My master was called "Hero of our Era."

But, eventually...my master became
unable to do anything by himself.
What do you mean...?
I provided for him far too much.

I thought helping my master with any
responsibility would benefit him...

But he cried to me, saying he was unable
to make any more decisions...

Ah, that's not your fault, Kirumi...
They were just too reliant on you.
No, it was my fault.
It was a good experience for you
You're like a doting mother
I'm surprised you messed up like that
Are you unsure of something?

I only thought about my own actions
and neglected my master's feelings...

It may not be a fond memory,
but it was a good experience for you.

Perhaps...
I was able to re-evaluate myself as a maid.

My principle of selfless devotion stems
from this experience.
You're like a doting mother.

<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
Did I say something wrong?

Please do not call me a mother...
We are the same age.

That can be taken as an insult for a woman.
Think about it before you say it.

O-Oh, okay.
I'm sorry.

<CLT=cltMIND>Could she be...self-conscious
about that?

I'm surprised that you messed up
like that.

Like I told you before,
I am not an all-knowing, perfect machine.

I am just like you...
An inexperienced highschooler.
I will not make the same mistakes again...

But there is still a weakness I cannot
overcome... It is my most fearful enemy.

Your most fearful enemy?
What's that?
Konjac...
...Huh?
I cannot cut konjac...
...What!?

I assume you have not noticed...
I never use konjac in my cooking.

<CLT=cltMIND>Now that you mention it...
I suppose that's true!

I have been avoiding it to elude suspicion...
But I am prepared to dice it and use it!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Kirumi's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time trying to teach
Kirumi how to cut konjac.
